name: ShipFast Engineering
tagline: An engineering org in numbers — PRs, deploys, incidents and DORA metrics.
description: Six product & platform teams. Pull requests are merged (merged_at), closed without merge (closed_at) or still open (both NULL). Deployments go to staging or production; incidents may be linked to the production deployment that caused them. Perfect for DORA-style metrics: lead time, change failure rate, MTTR.
